name: 731-stale-install-refused-before-provision
note: #731: a launch from a plugin root one bump behind the engine (lgtmgate 1.6.0-beta.35 after a lead-merge bump to beta.36, the stale local install incident): the run stops at the version probe, before provisioning, any session, any worktree and any label write; callLabels holds the version probe only. The provision entry models the stale root's provision probe, which the engine never reaches. #731 turns the same refusal into a pre-launch `plugin-versions.sh --check` (deliver step 0) and makes lead-merge update the local install.

args.brief: a launch on a stale install must be refused before any session or worktree exists

expect.reason: plugin-version-skew: the plugin root holds lgtmgate 1.6.0-beta.35 (beta channel) but this engine is @@ENGINE_VERSION@@ (@@ENGINE_CHANNEL@@ channel); pass the current plugin root and relaunch; see docs/consumer-reference.md, Run reasons, plugin-version-skew
logsInclude: pass the current plugin root and relaunch
